verses.1: You seek out love, but you despise the spiritual things. It’s better for you to prophesy instead.
verses.2: For he speaks not to people in human language, but to God. No one indeed hears him; it is the Spirit who speaks through him.
verses.3: And the prophet, in speaking to people, also spoke of building houses, of prayers, and of miracles.
verses.4: He builds his own house in the language he speaks; while those who prophesy build a church.
verses.5: I want all of you to speak in languages that are understandable by others. But more importantly, I want you to prophesy. It’s better for someone to prophesy than to just talk in a language that isn’t understood by others. This way, the church can be built on a solid foundation.
verses.6: Now, brothers, if I come to you and speak in words, what benefit can I bring to you, if I do not explain things to you through revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?
verses.7: However, since the voices are produced by instruments like guitars or violins, if there’s no sound from those instruments, how can it be determined whether what’s being played is a guitar or a violin?
verses.8: And surely, if a cicada makes a loud noise, who would prepare for war then?
verses.9: Also, if you don’t speak clearly in your language, how can anyone understand what you’re saying? After all, you’re speaking into the air.
verses.10: Perhaps there are many kinds of voices in the world, but none of them truly silent.
verses.11: If I don’t know the power of my voice, then I will be rude when I speak, and it will be rude for me to speak in such a manner.
verses.12: Similarly, you also, since you are eager for more spiritual things, should ask for more space in the building of the church.
verses.13: Therefore, I pray in this language so that it can be interpreted properly.
verses.14: For if I pray in a language, then my breath prays along with me; but my mind remains inactive.
verses.15: What is it then? I will pray to the spirit, and I will also pray to the mind. I will speak to the spirit, and I will also speak to the mind.
verses.16: Since, if it’s a blessed spirit, then how can the Amun fill that place of solitude? What do you say? You said you didn’t know.
verses.17: You, however, thanked me properly. But the other person won’t be able to build a house.
verses.18: I thank the God; I speak in your language, which is far better for all of you.
verses.19: But in the church, I want to speak five words at a time, so that I can also teach others. In other words, I want to say just a few words at a time, using language.
verses.20: Brothers, do not become children of evil; instead, grow up to be good people. Only then will you truly become perfect.
verses.21: It is written in the law that I must speak to this people in their own language and in their own words. But they won’t listen to me at all, says the Lord.
verses.22: So, languages serve as signs for those who believe, not for those who do not believe. And prophecy also serves as a sign for those who believe, not for those who do not believe.
verses.23: If then the entire church comes together to speak about this matter, and everyone speaks in their own languages, but those who are biased or dishonest refuse to do so, won’t they be punished for their actions?
verses.24: But if all the prophets’ predictions come true, then anyone who is dishonest or selfish will be brought before everyone else. They will be questioned by everyone.
verses.25: The secrets of his heart become visible. In this way, he will be able to worship the God, declaring that indeed, God is within you.
verses.26: What is it, brothers? When you gather together, each of you has a song to sing, a message to convey, a way of expressing oneself, and an understanding of what’s being said. All these things are necessary for building a house.
verses.27: Whether someone speaks in one language, or in two or three languages, and also in some other ways; and one can interpret it differently as well.
verses.28: But if the interpreter doesn’t do this, then he should speak quietly in the church, and speak to himself as well as to God.
verses.29: But two or three of them spoke out, while the others remained silent.
verses.30: But if he is discovered sitting there again, the first one will remain silent.
verses.31: For surely, one person can prophesy for everyone, so that all may learn and all may pray.
verses.32: And the spirits of the prophets are under control of those who prophesy.
verses.33: For God does not desire discord, but peace, as is true in all the churches of the saints.
verses.34: The women in the churches remained silent; it is not allowed for them to speak. They had to remain quiet, as the law requires.
verses.35: But if they want to learn anything, they should do so in their own homes. It’s inappropriate for a woman to speak in a church.
verses.36: Did God’s word come from without you, or was it destined to reach only you?
verses.37: If anyone thinks that he is a prophet or a spiritual being, then please note what I write to you: he is indeed a prophet.
verses.38: And if anyone denies it, then he shall be considered to be denying it.
verses.39: So, my brothers, you should avoid speaking in a way that is not appropriate or proper. Do not speak in a manner that is not acceptable.
verses.40: But I will always act in a polite and orderly manner.
